stages.name: imported
stages.hook: Immediately after existing initDesign(), before pin-access/guide/preparation/TA.

stages.name: before_dr
stages.hook: Immediately before existing dr(), after unchanged preparation/TA.

stages.name: after_dr
stages.hook: Immediately after existing dr(), before existing endFR().

stages.name: after_writer
stages.hook: Immediately after existing endFR(), before Tcl writes routed-fixed.odb/.def.

observer.disabled_behavior: An absent environment variable returns before inspecting or changing any engine object.
observer.enabled_behavior: Read-only native C++ getters; exact named ordinary-net/fixed-state/census checks. No setters, routing options, net-class changes, worker scheduling or algorithm decisions are patched.
observer.output: Four exclusive, no-follow stage files in a pre-existing absolute directory. Every complete line is written immediately; bounded incomplete prefix remains on a later failure. A complete marker alone does not prove successful fsync/close or job completion.
preserved_evidence: segment endpoints/width/extension styles and bounding boxes
every lower/cut/upper via component with source ordinal and multiplicity
internal layer index separately from native OID/name
native raw opcode/data pairs and actual native shape iterator components
internal fixed state, native net OID/class and terminal counts
observer.scope_exclusion: Three selected nets only. Existing full-chip native guards must establish all non-target and all 1691 original clock conservation; this witness does not claim complete internal conservation of every other fixed net.
observer.normal_mode_precondition: Future wrapper must bind the exact original non-distributed, non-single-step Tcl/debug settings. The native-before-writer equality deliberately refuses any earlier debug Writer update rather than waiving it.

comparison.material: Exact integer rectangle unions by actual native layer name; separately retained raw rows and multisets identify segmentation and duplicate-component differences.
comparison.diagnostic_fact: A fixed selected net changing internal material during DR while emitted material stays unchanged is reported as an observed internal/output difference, only after authentic complete stages and external input/output joins.
comparison.forbidden_inference: Synthetic controls, internal zero-marker count, or a complete parser result do not establish an accepted physical repair or the historical run's cause.

required_unchanged_gates: all other ordinary net native geometry, route encoding and DEF records
complete original-class JSON/TR DRC, not fixed-overlay-only DRC
20/4/8/8 ns and 5 percent original timing constraints
